caption:
Tuesday's Sky is Yin Metal, The Jewel 💎 Find your Day Master below.

Your Day Master is the element of the day you were born. Today's polished jewel meets it and creates one of 10 forces: Yin Metal gets a friend day, Yin Earth gets a joy day, Yin Wood feels the squeeze.

Don't know yours? Find it free at the link in bio.

Which line is too accurate? Comment below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #horoscope #zodiacsigns #fengshui #metaphysics #fourpillars #chineseastrology #astrologyreels #singapore
day_line: A jewel on a Snake day. Polished and sharp-eyed: good for details and quality work, easy to nitpick.

lines.Yang Wood: Someone senior likes your work today. Take the feedback and the credit.
lines.Yin Wood: A picky request lands today. Do it properly once, then let it go.
lines.Yang Fire: Good day to compare prices before you tap. The other shop might be cheaper.
lines.Yin Fire: An unexpected yes comes your way today. Act on it before lunch ends.
lines.Yang Earth: You'll want to rewrite someone's email today. Suggest edits; don't take over.
lines.Yin Earth: Treat yourself today: nice stationery or a good kaya toast. Small joy, big lift.
lines.Yang Metal: A colleague wants the same project today. Talk it out; there's room for two.
lines.Yin Metal: Your kind of people are on form today. Plan something together; keep the chat short.
lines.Yang Water: Someone has a useful tip today. Ask, listen, then make it your own.
lines.Yin Water: Things click quietly today. Write down the idea before the next notification.
